newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-OGIWARA WINS NORDIC COMBINED WORLD TITLE.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-OGIWARA WINS NORDIC COMBINED WORLD TITLE.

text.p: Japanese Kenji Ogiwara deprived Norway of a first gold medal by winning the Nordic combined title at the Nordic skiing world championships on Sunday.
Ogiwara, the 1993 world champion, won a close battle with Norway's Bjarte Engen Vik in the event's second part, the 15-km freestyle cross-country race, before crossing the line in front.
Vik briefly enjoyed the lead but he then let Ogiwara break away and had to be content with second place.
Fabrice Guy of France, who had achieved little since winning the 1992 Olympic title in Albertville, took the bronze medal.
Ogiwara was second after Sunday's ski jumping behind Finn Samppa Lajunen, who soon lost touch with the winning trio in the cross-country race.
